meta.title: Avesta
meta.description: Bus and train tickets in Uzbekistan, bought for you by a person.

home.heading: Bus and train tickets in Uzbekistan
home.intro: Tell us the journey. A person here buys the ticket and sends you the PDF.

promise.refund: We buy your ticket after your money arrives, not before. If the berth is gone by then we offer you the next departure, or refund everything including our fee.
promise.cards: We never ask for card numbers and never will.
promise.timing: A person buys each ticket by hand. Normally within 4 hours, always within 12.
promise.passport: The railway prints the passport number on the ticket, and the conductor checks it against the passport on board. That is the only reason we ask for it.

results.count: {count, plural, =0 {No trains} one {# train} other {# trains}}
results.soldOutCount: {count, plural, one {# sold out} other {# sold out}}
results.stale: The railway is not answering. These are the last prices we have, from {time} Tashkent time.

empty.heading: No trains on this date
empty.body: The railway lists nothing from {from} to {to} on this date. Try the day before or after. Sales also open some weeks ahead, so a date far in the future may not be on sale yet.

failed.heading: The railway did not answer
failed.body: This is their booking system, not the trains. Trains may well be running. Try again in a minute.

unserved.heading: We do not sell this journey
unserved.body: Train tickets through us run between Tashkent, Samarkand, Bukhara, Khiva and Urgench.

invalid.missing: Tell us where you are going, and when.
invalid.unknownCity: We do not sell train tickets from {city}. Trains through us run between Tashkent, Samarkand, Bukhara, Khiva and Urgench.
invalid.badDate: That date is not one we can read. Use the search form.
invalid.pastDate: That date has passed. Pick today or a later date.
invalid.heading: That search needs a change

row.seats: {count, plural, one {# seat left} other {# seats left}}

unpriced.heading: No price for this train
unpriced.body: The railway lists it, but the fare it sent back did not look right, so we are not quoting one.

times.nextDay: {days, plural, one {arrives the next day} other {arrives # days later}}
times.onTheWay: {time} on the way, as the railway states it

classes.seats: {count, plural, one {# seat left} other {# seats left}}

berth.free: {count, plural, =0 {none free right now} other {# free right now}}
berth.reality: Nobody can reserve a specific berth on Uzbek railways in advance — not us, not the railway's own site until the moment of purchase. We ask for the berth you prefer and tell you which one you got.

booking.nothingHeld: Choosing here holds nothing. A person buys the ticket after your money arrives, and you see the full price before you pay.

soldOut.heading: This train is sold out
soldOut.body: The railway has nothing left on it now. It may have gone in the minutes since you saw the list.

unpriced.heading: No price for this train
unpriced.body: The railway lists it, but the fare it sent back did not look right, so we are not quoting one.

notFound.heading: We cannot find that train
notFound.body: The railway is not listing it on this journey and date. The link may be an old one, or the timetable may have changed.

passengers.heading: Who is travelling?
passengers.intro: The railway prints these details on the ticket, so they have to match the passport exactly. A person here retypes them into the railway's own form.
passengers.full: Four passengers is the most one order can hold. Make a second order for a larger group.

names.hint: Copy the names from the two machine-readable lines at the bottom of the passport page. Those are always unaccented Latin letters — MÜLLER is written MUELLER there, and that is the spelling the railway needs.

gender.hint: The railway's form offers these two and the ticket has to match the passport.

passengers.passportHint: Letters and digits only, exactly as printed. No spaces.

contact.emailHint: The PDF ticket and every update about this order go to this address.
contact.noPhone: We do not ask for a phone number. Foreign numbers do not reliably reach Uzbek systems, and this is the one thing that has to arrive.

errors.latin_only: Use only the unaccented Latin letters printed in the machine-readable lines. Ü is UE there and É is E.
errors.too_long: That is longer than the railway's form accepts. Use the passport spelling.
errors.passport_format: A passport number is 5 to 15 letters and digits. Copy it exactly as printed.
errors.duplicate_passport: Two passengers cannot travel on one passport number. Check which document belongs to whom.
errors.birth_date_unreadable: That is not a date we can read.
errors.birth_date_future: A date of birth cannot be in the future.
errors.birth_date_too_old: Check the year. That is more than 120 years ago.
errors.unknown_country: Choose the issuing country from the list.
errors.email_unreadable: That address does not look complete. The ticket goes there, so it has to be right.

noClass.heading: Choose a class first
noClass.body: This link does not say which class you want. The classes on this train, and what each costs, are on the page you came from.

classGone.heading: That class is no longer listed
classGone.body: The railway is not listing {code} on this train any more. It may have sold out in the last few minutes. The other classes are on the page you came from.

priceChanged.heading: The price changed
priceChanged.body: {code} was {was, number} sum when you chose it. The railway is asking {now, number} sum now. Nothing has been booked and nothing has been charged.

review.heading: Check this before you continue
review.berthRequest: We will ask for a {berth} berth and tell you which one you got.
review.berthAny: You did not ask for a particular berth, so we will take what the railway gives.
review.adultFare: Everyone here is quoted the adult fare. If the railway charges less for a child, we write to you and refund the difference.

unbuilt.heading: This is as far as we have built
unbuilt.body: Payment is the next step and it is not finished yet. Nothing has been booked, no money has been asked for, and the passenger details have not left this page.

footer.fee: Our fee is 10%, always shown as its own line.
